title: Rabbi Abba, brother of Rav (son of Rav Mesharshiya)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: This is the reading in Masoret HaShas, [Eruvin 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.24a.20). He says, “This is what was said in Rava’s name.”[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The source title’s phrase “son of Rav Mesharshiya” is retained, but its attachment within the compressed brother-and-father chain remains open.

The linked Davidson text gives “father” in the phrase about Rav, and reads הכי אמרינן, “this is what we say,” in the report from Rava. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=77&lang=en) records the same family wording and offers alternative ways to read it.

Hyman (vol. I, p. 11) gives “brother” and prints הכי אמרינן, “this is what we say,” where the supplied text has הכי אמרה. In the consulted Shas Nehardea page of Eruvin 24a, the main text has (אבוה), “father.” Masoret HaShas, note ח, directs reading אחוה, “brother.” The separate note ט gives the Ya’avetz reading דרבא. Hyman elsewhere (vol. III, p. 1038) discusses both readings and proposes a different ordering. The title here follows Hyman’s heading, with the family attachment left open.
